title: Phase-02 Credential Mint/Consume Ledger
description: Every credential/claim the system mints (cookie, JWT, CSRF token, signed/presigned URL, capability cookie, API key, session, feature-flag gate, licence), with its WRITE sites (mint) and READ sites (consume) and the resources it is supposed to gate. lib/validate-egress.py asserts a consumer sits on every byte-serving path to each protected resource — the 'control with no enforcer' detector, mechanized.

name.description: The claim's identifier (cookie name, token name, header).

writers.description: Mint sites. Each is where the claim is issued/set.

readers.description: Consume sites. Each is where the claim is validated/honored.

validation_at_readers.description: What each reader actually checks (signature, expiry, allow-list). Ranked by validate-egress.py to infer the gate strength the credential implies.

protects_resources.description: Canonical data_model entity ids this credential is supposed to gate. If a protected resource has a byte-serving path that never consumes this credential, that path is a finding.
